text:
Ivy: quick notes from the playground QA + design pass. main pain: schema inspector doesn't scale for long function defs, and replay/run-history sometimes fails to hydrate the schema view. jotting decisions here. :memo:
Marco: saw the inspector collapse vertical space aggressively; examples and the copy action get hidden on narrow viewports. also code block not selectable by keyboard in current UI. :clipboard:
Zoe: accessibility: prefer an explicit 'Copy example' text button (icon + label). tooltip only is poor for screen readers. also aria-live should announce success and remain accessible until the next action.
Cal: run-history replay bug: when replaying an old timeline entry that included tool-calls, the inspector shows an empty placeholder until you toggle the tool header. looks like lazy import + virtualization bug. repro steps: 
```
- Open Playground -> Run history
- Click an entry that invoked tools
- Expand the tool call block
- Schema area displays blank until you collapse/expand again
```
Cal: can reproduce on staging. will add unit that ensures initial DOM contains formatted schema when expanded.
Ivy: UX proposal: default to a compact centered modal that can be detached into a persistent right-side inspector. modal reduces layout shift; detach supports side-by-side diffs with outputs.
Marco: implementation thoughts: allow "folding" for large schemas (show top-level keys + counts) and a "Show full" affordance. paginate huge payloads (>150 lines). reuse ui/prettyJson util where possible.
Zoe: microcopy: change CTA from "View schema" to "Open request schema (read-only)" and show small hint under the button: "Tip: press ⌘/Ctrl+C to copy example".
Cal: copy UX: support keyboard shortcut for code block (Cmd/Ctrl+C when focused) and update tooltip to not disappear immediately. use aria-live polite region with text "Example copied" and keep it in the accessibility tree until next copy.
Marco: visual/accessibility: clipboard icon (#97A0AA) fails contrast for 12px. either bump icon size to 14px or switch to #555F66. add visible focus ring on keyboard tab. add a CI lint that flags failing icon colors in the design tokens.
Ivy: keyboard flow: when modal opens focus search input; Tab order: search -> fold toggles -> pagination -> copy -> close. Esc should close modal. For detached panel, preserve same shortcuts and support global close.
Zoe: small UX caveat: when a detached inspector is open and you navigate to another run-history entry, keep detached inspector open and refresh its content. sessionStorage or UI state can persist detach preference.
Cal: backlog owners:
- Cal: investigate hydration/lazy-load in run-history + add test coverage (owner)
- Marco: implement modal + detach + fold/paginate for big schemas (owner)
- Zoe: copy a11y (aria-live persistent feedback + keyboard shortcut) (owner)
- Ivy: microcopy + design tokens update + CI color lint (owner)
Ivy: please add time estimates to RD-UX ticket and mark anything >2d for planning.
Marco: quick poll: react :one: for modal default, :two: for panel default.
Ivy: :one: (modal + detach)
Marco: :one:
Zoe: :one: (modal default)
AssistBot: created ticket RD-UX-3382 "Playground schema inspector: modal default + detach, fold/paginate large schemas, copy a11y, run-history hydration fix" and linked this thread.
